2,970 likes, 421 comments - _puneetrao_ on October 9, 2026: "Parul didn’t become consistent overnight. She missed workouts, came back, missed again, and kept coming back. ❤️

And look at her today!

If you’ve been waiting to feel ready, to get fitter first, or to find the perfect time to start, I want you to know that you can begin exactly where you are.

I’ll take care of the workouts. You just have to show up, even if that means starting again. 🩵

Comment MOVE and I’ll personally show you how to start training with me on MoveDaily from tomorrow!".

880 likes, 93 comments - movedailywithpuneet on October 8, 2026: "I wish I could show you what I get to see from this side of the screen. 🥹♥️

The familiar names showing up every morning, the comments after every workout, the little victories you share, and some of you slowly starting to believe in yourselves again.

After all these years of coaching, these are still the things that mean the most to me.

And I hope, a few months from now, you look back and feel really glad that you kept going.

Can I ask you something? What’s one change you’ve noticed in yourself since you started MoveDaily?

It doesn’t have to be physical. I’d genuinely love to know. ♥️".

635 likes, 20 comments - _puneetrao_ on October 6, 2026: "You’ve become so good at living with certain things that sometimes you forget to question them.

Not every late period means something is wrong. But repeatedly missing periods, unusually heavy bleeding, or losing your period while dieting deserves attention.

Please don’t just get used to something without understanding why it’s happening.

Save this. And share it with a woman you care about. ❤️

There are things about our bodies we should have been taught much earlier.".
